title: Farmhand player command v1
description: A proposal from the language layer (rules, a local model, or the fixed key). It carries no authority: the coordinator adds request id and farm, and the executor validates the resulting intent (intent.schema.json) and selects all equipment. No vehicle IDs, coordinates or control values can be expressed.

command.description: fetch_pair: bring an available tractor and forage wagon, hitched. move_pair: move the hitched tractor and forage wagon the requester refers to ('this'; the pair nearest them). stop: cancel the current job now. status: report the current job. settings: open the Farmhand AI menu in game.

target.description: fetch_pair and move_pair. Default 'here' (the requester's position when accepted). A place is named in the player's words (an AutoDrive marker name or part of an owned building's name).
